exposure: women who preferred vaginal delivery but underwent cesarean section
women who preferred cesarean section but underwent vaginal delivery
outcome: inconsistency between preferred and actual mode of delivery
cohort: Pregnant women at the maternity hospital with the largest number of deliveries in Beijing
finding: The inconsistency rate between preferred delivery at late pregnancy and actual delivery is high in China, with maternal obesity, assisted reproduction, abnormal amniotic fluid volume, and fetal distress increasing the risk of inconsistency between preferred vaginal delivery and actual cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pre-labor rupture of membranes was uniquely associated with inconsistency between cesarean section preference and vaginal delivery.
